english: The list of bishoprics: An exposition by Epiphanius, Archbishop of Cyprus, of the precedence of patriarchs and metropolitans. The Patriarch of Rome, the Patriarch of Constantinople, the Patriarch of Alexandria, the Patriarch of Antioch, the Patriarch of Jerusalem. The calling of metropolitans: a) of the Province of Cappadocia, Caesarea; b) of the Province of Asia, Ephesus; c) of the Province of Europe, Heraclea; d) of the Province of Galatia, Ancyra; e) of the Province of Hellespont, Cyzicus; f) of the Province of Lydia, Sardis; g) of the Province of Bithynia, Nicomedia; h) of the same Province, Nicaea; i) of the same Province, Chalcedon; j) of the Province of Pamphylia, Side; k) of the Province of Armenia II, Sebastea; l) of the Province of Helenopontus, Amasia; m) of the Province of Armenia I, Melitene; n) of the Province of Cappadocia II, Tyana; o) of the Province of Paphlagonia, Gangra; p) of the Province of Honoriada, Claudiopolis; q) of the Province of Pontus, Neocaesarea; r) of the Province of Galatia II, Pisidia; s) of the Province of Lycia, Myra; t) of the Province of Caria, Stavroupolis; u) of the Province of Phrygia, Laodicea; v) of the Province of Phrygia Salutarica, Synada; w) of the Province of Lycaonia, Iconium; x) of the Province of Pisidia, Antioch; y) of the Province of Pamphylia, Perga; z) of the Province of Cappadocia II, Mopsuestia; aa) of the Province of Lazica, Phaselis; bb) of the Province of Thrace, Philippopolis; cc) of the Province of Europe, Trajanopolis; dd) of the Province of the Cyclades, Rhodes; ee) of the Province of Haemimontus, Adrianople; ff) of the same Province, Marcianopolis; gg) of the Province of Phrygia Cappadociana, Hierapolis. Concerning the autocephalous archbishops: a) of the Province of Mysia, Odyssos; b) of the Province of Scythia, Tomis; c) of the Province of Europe, Byzantium.

d. In the Province of Paphlagonia, Pompeiopolis. e. In the Province of Asia, Smyrna. In the Province of Isauria, Leontopolis. f. In the Province of Rhodope, Maronia. g. In the Province of Bithynia, Apamea. h. In the Province of Rhodope, Maximianopolis. i. In the Province of Galatia, the Germans. j. In the Province of Europe, Arcadiopolis. k. In the Province of Thrace, Verone. l. In the Province of the Island of Lesbos, Mytilene. m. In the Province of the Hellespont, Paros. n. In the Province of Caria, Miletus. o. In the Province of Thrace, Nicopolis. p. In the Province of the Island, Prokonnesos. q. In the Province of Rhodope, Anchialus. r. In the Province of Europe, Selymbria. s. In the Province of the Island of Lesbos, Methymna. t. In the Province of Bithynia, Kyu. u. In the Province of Europe, Apron. v. In the Province of Rhodope, Kympsala. w. In the Province of Zechia, Cherson. x. In the same Province, the Bosporus. y. In the same Province, Nicopsa. z. In the Province of Isauria, Kotrados. η. In the Province of the Hellespont, Euchaita. θ. In the Province of the Cyclades Islands, Karpathos. ι. In the Province of Rhodope, Aenus. κ. In the Province of Europe, Dryziparoi. λ. In the Province of Aimiton, Mesembria. μ. In the Province of Armenia B, Heracleopolis. ν. In the Province of Abasgia, Sebastopolis.

Concerning the overseeing bishops: Province of Cappadocia A, Metropolis of Caesarea, which has under it cities, namely bishoprics: namely, those of the Thermal Basilika, Nysis, Theodosiopolis of Armenia, the Kamulianoi, and Kikisou. Province of Asia, Metropolis of Ephesus, which has under it cities, namely bishoprics: twelve, such as those of Hypeton, Tralles, Magnesia, Meander, Elaia, Adramyttium, Assos, Gargarus, Mastoura, Kaloi, and Bryola.

english: Pitane, Myrina, Phocaea, Aureliopolis, Nymphaion, Maschakom, the Metropolitans, Vareto, Magnesia and Anelia, Anina, Pergamon, Priela, Arcadiopolis, Andreas, the Temple of Zeus, Augaza, Sion, Colophon, Lebedus, Teos, Erythrae, Eklyzomenoi, Antandros, Theodosiopolis, Perperis, Cyme, and Palaeopolis. Province of Europe in Thrace: The Metropolis of Heracleia has five cities, namely the bishoprics of Panium, Callipolis, Chersonesus, Kula, and Rhaidesto.

Province of Galatia [Thrace]: The Metropolis of Ancyra has six cities, namely the bishoprics of Tabia, Heliopolis, Asponis, Berinopolis, Mnēzus, and Kinē, and Anastasiopolis. Province of Hellespont: The Metropolis of Cyzicus has twelve cities, namely the bishoprics of Germē, Pemanos, Okes, Sasabares, Adrian of the Beasts, Lampsacus, Abydos, Dardanos, Ilios, Troy, Pionia, and Melitupolis.

Province of Lydia: The Metropolis of Sardis has ten cities, namely the bishoprics of Philadelphia, Tripolis, Thyatira, Settos, Aureliopolis, Tripolis, Gordos, Tralles, Salos, Silandus, Maionia, the Temple of Apollo, Hyrcanides, Mustines, Akrasa, Apolloniades, Attaleia, Bagē, Blandus, Mesotymolos, Hierocaesarea, Dalda, Kerasē, Stratonikeia, Gabala, Sattalos, and Hermoupolis. Province of Bithynia: The Metropolis of Nicomedia has seven cities, namely the bishoprics of Prousia or Theopolis, Basilopolis, Praeneta, Apolloniades, Dasculium, Gallos, Neocaesarea, and Kolasia or Lophos.

Province of the same [Bithynia]: The Metropolis of Nicaea has three cities, namely the bishoprics of Modrin or Melitus, Linōē, and Gordoserbon. Province of the same [Bithynia]: The Metropolis of Chalcedon. Province of Pamphylia: The Metropolis of Side has ten cities, namely the bishoprics of Selge, Aspendus, Ettene, Orymnus, Kasōn, Semneōn, Karalia, Karakisia, Syedron, Miloma or Justinianopolis, Ouamandron, Dalisan, Isbos, Lyrbe, Kolibrassos, and Manaygon.

Province of Armenia II: The Metropolis of Sebaste has five cities, namely the bishoprics of Sebaste, Nicopolis, Sattalos, Coloniae, and Berissa. Province of Helenopontus: The Metropolis of Amasia has [number missing] cities, namely the bishoprics of Aminso, Sinope, Iboron, Andrapōn, Zalichon or Leontopolis, and Zelon.
